summary: #smallpoems A maze of misery Girdles our Trees of Liberty killing at edges vines of Bittersweet climbing choking Hungry thirst siphoning sucking on resources while greed steals the sun leaving us to mire in tangled darkness at the door of reclaimed history at edges of society a nasty force we must uproot hands dirty in work of getting it done.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
A maze
of misery
Girdles our
Trees of Liberty
killing at edges
vines of Bittersweet
   climbing
     choking
Hungry
thirst
siphoning
  sucking
on resources
while greed steals
the
  sun
   leaving us
to mire
in tangled darkness
at the door
of reclaimed
history
at edges
  of society
a nasty force we
   must uproot
hands dirty
  in work
of getting
it done.
